subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the security-sensitive Codex, token-minting, scanning, and publishing action upgrades land together after contract validation, or be split from the routine setup-action updates?
rationale: The patch changes third-party code executed with credentials and publishing privileges, and repository policy requires maintainer ownership of that security boundary plus direct Codex contract inspection.

options.title: Validate and land the batch
options.body: Refresh the branch, inspect the sensitive upstream diffs and Codex contract, then merge the grouped pins after representative exact-head workflows pass.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Move codex-action, create-github-app-token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing pins into separately reviewed PRs while retaining routine setup-action updates here.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Keep the PR open without merging until the security label owner can complete the dependency review and workflow proof.

recommendation.title: Validate and land the batch
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, inspect the sensitive upstream diffs and Codex contract, then merge the grouped pins after representative exact-head workflows pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to release-workflow hardening, and the timeline shows awareness of this PR.
